item.title: Fatality forces emergency closure of Nottinghamshire level crossing
item.description: Following a fatality, an emergency order has been granted to close a footpath level crossing across a railway line in Nottinghamshire.

item.title: Peak Rail confirms dates for 2026 Rail and Road gala
item.description: Peak Rail in Derbyshire has announced that its joint Rail and Road gala will take place on Saturday 30 and Sunday 31 May next year.

item.title: Boxing Day trains to run to Aberdeen for first time
item.description: Trains will run to Aberdeen this Boxing Day for the first time, rail operator, ScotRail, has announced. Trains will run between Aberdeen and Edinburgh as well as Arbroath and Edinburgh. Complementing the Boxing Day timetable, which will operate in the Strathclyde area as well as Perth, Alloa, Dunblane, Dundee, Leven,…

item.title: Model railway factory tours make ideal Christmas gifts
item.description: Model railway manufacturer PECO, has announced a range of ideal Christmas gifts for model railway enthusiasts.

item.title: Polar Bear to star this Christmas at Severn Valley Railway
item.description: This year, the Severn Valley Railway has a new star for its Santa Steam Specials, which start running this weekend.

item.title: Avanti West Coast recognised for commitment to inclusive culture
item.description: Train operating company Avanti West Coast is celebrating having received an Investors in Diversity Bronze Award.

item.title: Heart of Wales line to see Increased Services from mid-December
item.description: The Mid Wales line is to see 5 trains a day each way from December 14th

item.title: LNER colleagues create Azuma-themed planter for Lincolnshire station
item.description: Two LNER colleagues working at Grantham station have used their skills at handiwork to create a new welcome for passengers.
